column3: With respect to the Commerce Office Park Mortgage Loan (5.9%), (i) the largest tenant, County of Los Angeles, Child Support Services Department, has rent abatement for the month of February 2026, and (ii) the third largest tenant, County of Los Angeles, Sheriff Department, has rent abatement for the month of August 2026. In each case, a rent concession reserve required for related abatement amounts. In addition, the rent for the largest tenant, County of Los Angeles, Child Support Services Department, the second largest tenant, State of California, Department of Justice, and the third largest tenant, County of Los Angeles, Sheriff Department, was underwritten on a straight line rent averaging basis.
